title: CB2-L1: does the individual learn from its own lived experience, and can we tell? (learning twin vs frozen twin)
authority: DAV-98, approved by David ('Please proceed', 2026-10-10 03:29 CT); defaults for the open questions recorded on DAV-98 (L-C first; amnesic twin deferred; DreamerV3 baseline reported, not gating; drives = env reward + death signal); revised before launch with Sol's review (DAV-98, 2026-10-10 04:18 CT): reference twin added, drive spec fixed, primitive-action prediction and L2 made explicit, DreamerV3 comparison terms set
principle: competence from learning, not rules we write; scaffolding listed and measured

twins.source: S2b (state cc8948e7..., weights 8cffde79...), the canonical's current skill; copies, never the canonical itself
twins.learning: sleeps after every wake (L-A core, selector re-anchoring by self-distillation, L-C chooser); each sleep is one consolidation event in its own home
twins.reference: sleeps exactly like the learning twin (same starting weights, same update counts, same budget, same per-cycle seeds) but always on a FIXED buffer: the cycle-0 lives only, never its later experience. Tests whether its own accumulating experience helps beyond extra optimisation. (Erasing memories only at evaluation would test retrieval, a separate question, not run here.)

experience.wake: 20 lives per cycle on practice run 9 (89,000,000 + cycle*10,000 + n), identical worlds for both twins
experience.sleep_data: its own wake lives (all cycles so far), alternated 1:1 with the canonical's 592 lived lives before the split (lived-cb2-ind-0001); no teacher labels, no routine, no privileged inputs
experience.drives: fixed in advance: the environment's reward, which carries perceived health change (+/-0.1 per health point, the same reading as its body sense), first achievement unlocks and caretaker requests; death as a terminal signal (-10). No other term: no separate damage penalty (no double counting), no rule-shaped terms (e.g. nothing for being outside at night: the model must learn that relationship). These encode objectives, not behaviour, and imply nothing about suffering.

probes.fresh: 40 new worlds per cycle (78100 + 100*cycle + i), full lives, paired learning vs frozen
probes.transfer: 40 new worlds per cycle (78600 + 100*cycle + i) under a different caretaker: arrival rate x2 (growth x2, max 1/20), family weights avoid 0.30, maintain 0.25 (practice never sees this)
probes.situations: a fixed bank built once from the frozen twin's lives on worlds 79100-79123: first dusk outside, first food<=3, first zombie within 3; each twin wakes there with a fresh mind for 300 steps; same bank every cycle (also retention)
probes.gate2_ablation: at cycle 10 the learning twin also runs every probe with its chooser off

primary.experience_causes_improvement: pooled over cycles 6-10: one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of paired survival (learning - reference) > 0 on fresh worlds AND on transfer worlds
primary.learning_helps_at_all: pooled over cycles 6-10: lower95 of paired survival (learning - frozen) > 0 on fresh AND transfer worlds
primary.situations: per situation, mean over cycles 6-10, paired: lower95 > 0 (vs reference and vs frozen, each reported)

secondary.retention: situation survival of the learning twin at cycle 10 minus cycle 5 (paired by situation): lower95 > -25 steps
secondary.gate2: cycle 10, chooser on - off, pooled over fresh+transfer: mean > 0 (reported; the chooser is credited only if > 0)
secondary.gate4: probe-life on the learning twin's core after cycle 10 vs the frozen r2 core (known-out-of-view R^2 and map-head balanced accuracy)
secondary.learned_authored_share: primitive actions authored by learning: 0% in L1 by construction (the executor is scripted), reported plainly; share of command decisions changed by the learned chooser per cycle
secondary.growth_curve: paired survival difference per cycle (fresh, transfer, situations), with the trend over cycles
secondary.primitive_action_prediction: built in from the start: the chooser's hands model predicts primitive actions from the core's state and a command; its accuracy is reported every sleep (precursor to L2)

reading.own_experience_shown: experience_causes_improvement holds on fresh and transfer (fresh-only = possible memorisation)
reading.optimisation_only: learning beats frozen but not reference: the gain comes from extra training, not from its experience

change_of_direction: no learning-vs-frozen advantage on fresh probes (pooled lower95 <= 0) -> the learner design is wrong; stop and redesign before scaling
advantage on fresh but not transfer -> memorisation; change objectives
chooser credited 0 and changed-decision share ~0 -> learned choice is not doing the work
learned-authored primitive share stays 0% -> L2 (learned hands, shelter/night first) is required next, not more selector work
not_claimed: technical continuity is not selfhood; this is development-level evidence (no sealed worlds are used in L1); a positive result would get its own sealed confirmation
integrity: crashes and deviations are reported, never silently rerun; cycle 0 (before any sleep) must show zero paired difference (identical twins): the instrument check
next_milestone: L2 (explicit): replace at least one scripted skill with learned primitive-action behaviour, shelter/night first (about 74% of damage deaths begin upstream) -- so the track does not return to the eight-command box
dreamerv3_baseline: run separately after L1, reported, not gating the track: matched observations, primitive actions, experience budget and the same drive specification. Beating it would gate a claim of superior control, not a claim of lifelong growth. Reference: Hafner et al., Nature 2025 (DreamerV3).
compute: one 4090 pod: wake (learning twin), two sleeps per cycle (learning, reference), probes for three twins per cycle; about 6-9 h
